name: What should I figure out first before remodeling my primary bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I figure out first before remodeling my primary bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by defining how the bathroom must function, then confirm the existing room dimensions, plumbing locations, ventilation, windows, storage, and electrical needs. A layout plan should come before selecting tile or fixtures because moving a toilet, shower, or vanity can substantially affect scope. Context: Elite Remodeling & Design can develop the layout, 3D design, selections, and construction plan as connected stages. Key factors: daily routines, clearance around fixtures, door swing, natural light, storage, and whether walls or plumbing must move. Practical guidance: measure the room, photograph every wall, list must-haves, and separate them from attractive extras. Ask for a written scope before approving finishes. Elite Remodeling & Design is suited to projects that need design decisions coordinated with construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin with function and layout, not tile. Record room dimensions, plumbing locations, storage needs, ventilation, lighting, and must-have features. Elite Remodeling & Design can use those details to develop a coordinated layout and 3D design before selections and construction begin.
